text:
## Quality Assurance  
### Error Checks  
**Before Approval:**
- [ ] All required fields completed
- [ ] KYC verification done (ID + Address)
- [ ] AML screening passed
- [ ] Risk assessment documented
- [ ] Approval obtained (per authority)
- [ ] Data entry accurate (spelling, numbers)  
**Post-Approval:**
- [ ] Account created correctly in system
- [ ] Initial balance (if any) recorded
- [ ] Linked systems updated
- [ ] Card ordered (if applicable)
- [ ] Customer notification sent
- [ ] Account status active

raw_entities.name: Quality Assurance Process
raw_entities.description: A comprehensive quality assurance workflow executed before and after account approval to verify all required fields, compliance checks, data accuracy, and system setup. The process includes pre-approval verification of KYC, AML screening, risk assessment, and approval authority, followed by post-approval validation of account creation, balance recording, system updates, card issuance, and customer notification.
context: Before Approval: All required fields completed, KYC verification done (ID + Address), AML screening passed, Risk assessment documented, Approval obtained (per authority), Data entry accurate (spelling, numbers)
Post-Approval: Account created correctly in system, Initial balance (if any) recorded, Linked systems updated, Card ordered (if applicable), Customer notification sent, Account status active

raw_entities.name: Required Fields Completion Check
raw_entities.description: Pre-approval verification step ensuring all mandatory fields are completed before proceeding with account approval.

raw_entities.name: KYC Verification
raw_entities.description: Pre-approval compliance step verifying customer identity and address documentation as part of Know Your Customer requirements.

raw_entities.name: AML Screening Validation
raw_entities.description: Pre-approval compliance step confirming that Anti-Money Laundering screening has been completed and passed before account approval.

raw_entities.name: Risk Assessment Documentation
raw_entities.description: Pre-approval step requiring formal documentation of the customer risk assessment before approval authority is obtained.

raw_entities.name: Approval Authority Verification
raw_entities.description: Pre-approval step confirming that appropriate approval has been obtained according to delegated authority limits.

raw_entities.name: Data Entry Accuracy Check
raw_entities.description: Pre-approval verification step validating the accuracy of all data entry, including spelling and numerical values.

raw_entities.name: Account System Creation Verification
raw_entities.description: Post-approval step confirming that the account has been created correctly in the banking system.

raw_entities.name: Initial Balance Recording
raw_entities.description: Post-approval step recording any initial balance deposited to the newly created account.

raw_entities.name: Linked Systems Update
raw_entities.description: Post-approval step ensuring that all linked banking systems are updated with the new account information.

raw_entities.name: Card Issuance
raw_entities.description: Post-approval step ordering a payment card for the customer account when applicable.

raw_entities.name: Customer Notification
raw_entities.description: Post-approval step notifying the customer that their account has been successfully created and is active.

raw_entities.name: Account Status Activation
raw_entities.description: Post-approval step confirming that the account status has been set to active and is ready for use.

raw_entities.name: Approval Authority Role
raw_entities.description: The role responsible for granting approval according to delegated authority limits during the pre-approval quality assurance phase.

raw_entities.name: KYC Verification Compliance Checkpoint
raw_entities.description: Mandatory pre-approval compliance gate verifying that Know Your Customer requirements have been satisfied through collection and verification of identity and address documentation.

raw_entities.name: AML Screening Compliance Checkpoint
raw_entities.description: Mandatory pre-approval compliance gate confirming that Anti-Money Laundering screening has been completed and passed before account approval can proceed.

raw_entities.name: Identity and Address Verification
raw_entities.description: Know Your Customer verification process requiring collection and validation of customer identity documentation and address proof as a pre-approval requirement.

raw_entities.name: AML Screening
raw_entities.description: Anti-Money Laundering screening process that must be completed and passed as a mandatory pre-approval compliance requirement.

raw_entities.name: New Account
raw_entities.description: A newly created customer account subject to the quality assurance process, requiring system creation, initial balance recording, and activation.

raw_entities.name: Payment Card
raw_entities.description: A payment card ordered and issued to the customer account as part of the post-approval quality assurance process when applicable.
